paragraphs: The M240i xDrive is the all-wheel-drive performance flagship of the current G42-generation 2 Series Coupe, which has been in production since 2021. It uses the B58 — a 3.0-litre twin-turbo inline-six petrol engine that's widely regarded as one of BMW's most robust modern power units. The B58 has been fitted across BMW's model range from the mid-2010s onward, with a strong reliability reputation that's backed by a closed-deck block design and well-proven architecture.
about.boldParagraph: The M240i xDrive is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
